notes: walter-secrets-sync keeps the shared Bitwarden session open for W.Alter; when the session expires, restarting it re-opens the session.
Only metadata is ever visible here; never ask for or print a secret value.
If the vault needs the master password, a new device approval or a 2FA code, only the owner can act: needs_owner.

A grant whose problems say 'refresh refused (HTTP 4xx) … new owner login needed' or 'access expired for N h and not renewed' (kind subscription or oauth, renewer walter-secrets) is a revoked sign-in at the provider (e.g. Claude Pro n°1, 23/11/2026). No restart, retry or file change fixes it and the guardian must never touch the token file: only the owner can sign in again. Outcome needs_owner; tell Monsieur which account (grant title) and that he only has to ask W.Alter (Claude Code) for the sign-in link (official PKCE link, then he sends back the code shown).
An api_key grant reported missing (no field / storage problem) means the Bitwarden item or field changed: needs_owner, naming the grant title; never guess a value.
